content.text: Submitted. The repaired fallback proposal now: (1) narrows Section 6.1 to the named Deerskin Products with a single tight deletion inside the same sentence (changed-character ratio within the 0.600 gate), and (2) adds one concise inserted sentence supplying the missing 12-month cap plus the internal-development and acquisition carve-outs, with the surplus "other products" limb and the "merged with"/"affiliates" broadening removed. Status remains **deviation** at the fallback level.
